title: LEAP-NBV: Lightweight Edge Active-Perception for Foundation-Model Next-Best-View Planning
abstract: arXiv:2609.23974v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models are endowing autonomous systems with greater intelligence, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of the environment through visual perception. A representative example is Human Mesh Recovery (HMR), which provides useful estimates of a target's 3D pose and shape that can benefit tactical missions. However, the size and power demands of such models make them difficult to run on edge platforms and limit their real-time performance, undermining the requirements of tactical edge deployment - especially for active perception, where a mobile robot must plan its next-best view on-board and cannot offload computation under contested communications. We present LEAP-NBV, a lightweight active-perception framework that runs foundation-model-driven Next-Best-View (NBV) planning on-board an edge device. translated_title: LEAP-NBV：面向基础模型下一最佳视角规划的轻量级边缘主动感知
translated_abstract: 基础模型正在赋予自主系统更高的智能，使其能够通过视觉感知对环境进行更全面的理解。一个代表性的例子是人体网格恢复（HMR），它能够提供目标三维姿态和形状的有用估计，从而服务于战术任务。然而，此类模型的规模和功耗需求使其难以在边缘平台上运行，并限制了其实时性能，无法满足战术边缘部署的要求——尤其是对于主动感知而言，移动机器人必须在机载设备上规划其下一最佳视角，且在通信受干扰的情况下无法将计算卸载到别处。我们提出了LEAP-NBV，这是一个轻量级的主动感知框架，能够在边缘设备上运行由基础模型驱动的下一最佳视角（NBV）规划。为此，我们通过离线网格目标函数，将一系列大型HMR教师模型分别蒸馏为紧凑的32M参数学生模型，随后……
tldr: 提出LEAP-NBV框架，通过将大型人体网格恢复基础模型蒸馏为紧凑的32M参数学生模型，实现了在边缘设备上机载实时运行基础模型驱动的下一最佳视角规划。
en_tdlr: LEAP-NBV is a lightweight active-perception framework that distills large Human Mesh Recovery foundation models into compact 32M students, enabling foundation-model-driven Next-Best-View planning to run on-board edge devices in real time.
